R1_redesign.what: expand action horizon H beyond 32 using the frozen checkpoint, measure CLOSED-LOOP in-box (mean stable in-target, relaxed) at 10 seeds
R1_redesign.H_constraint: H must be a multiple of 8 (9-frame data => H%(num_frames-1)==0, frames-1=8). 48/64/80/96 all valid; fine-scan +8 also valid; H52 invalid
R1_redesign.execute_policy: r = H (execute the whole predicted chunk) to test 'longer continuous execution'; safety on; 600 steps; 10 seeds
R1_redesign.escalation_rule: measure H=32/48/64 first; if H64 in-box > H48 and H64 shows a good result, add H=80; if H80 > H64 add H=96; keep adding +16 while (newest in-box > previous) ; STOP when non-increasing / plateau (|delta|<0.2) / clear decline
R1_redesign.fine_scan_rule: among coarse H points, take the 2-3 consecutive (+16) with the highest in-box; fine-scan that interval at +8 steps (e.g. best [64,80,96] -> test 72, 88)
R1_redesign.low_result_gate: if the best interval mean in-box < 2.0 cookies -> DO NOT fine-scan; just report the coarse result
R1_redesign.label: H>32 positions are UNTRAINED => exploratory OOD; never claim a 48/64 capability; report as observed in-box only
